title: Sources lock (.factory/sources.lock.yaml)
description: Where every input to the workspace came from, and — for a pinned description document — the vendor's pristine copy, the working copy the agent and the engineer may edit, and the patch set that turns one into the other. Kinds: `openapi` (OpenAPI 3.x) and `swagger` (Swagger 2.0) are pinned documents; `docs` and `probe` record pages read and live requests made. `supplement` is an OpenAPI 3 document the agent wrote of what the documentation or probes say and no pinned document does; the inventory is built from it beside the pinned documents. `postman` and `har` are planned.

kind.description: openapi = OpenAPI 3.x; swagger = Swagger 2.0. `graphos-factory-core sources pin` detects it from the document.

path.description: The working copy, relative to the workspace root: what `inventory build` reads and what people edit. Never under `.factory/sources/` (reserved for vendor copies) and never another entry's `upstream`.

upstream.description: The vendor's bytes as retrieved: a file directly under `.factory/sources/` (default `.factory/sources/<name>.upstream.<ext>`), never elsewhere, so `sources pin --force` cannot overwrite a working copy or the schema. Never edited: a change here is an error, not a hand edit.

upstream_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the upstream file's bytes.

sha256.description: Legacy: SHA-256 of the spec bytes before upstream/working copies were distinguished. Superseded by upstream_sha256; kept readable.

patches.description: JSON Patch (RFC 6902) operations that turn the upstream document into the working copy, each with the reason it exists. Written by `graphos-factory-core codify --source`; the hand edit is refused by lint until it is here. `was` keeps the value an operation replaced or removed so a refresh can tell a vendor change from a still-valid patch.

decision.description: Optional: the decision this patch carries out (a numbered or a random id), when it is one. `reason` carries the why.

context.description: Optional background beyond the reason, in prose (`codify --source --context`).

verified.description: How the patch was verified against the real API (a recorded sample, a docs page).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the page as retrieved, when the agent recorded one.

path.description: The document, relative to the workspace root and never under `.factory/`: OpenAPI 3, every operation citing where it was read (`x-source`, a URL or a workspace path). Edited directly; it has no upstream copy and no patches.

provenance.description: What its operations were read from: the vendor's documentation (confidence 0.9) or live requests (1).

credential.description: The environment variable's name, never its value.
